days.title: 霧の町
days.morning: Arrive in Sa Pa by sleeper bus, check in and have chicken phở for breakfast.
days.afternoon: Walk down to Cat Cat village, see Tien Sa waterfall and H'Mong houses.
days.evening: Visit the Stone Church and night market, enjoy grilled snacks and apple wine.

days.title: ファンシーパン制覇
days.morning: Take the cable car to the 3,143 m Fansipan summit, hunt clouds and visit the spiritual complex.
days.afternoon: See O Quy Ho pass, Silver Waterfall and Heaven's Gate.
days.evening: Try salmon hotpot and a Red Dao herbal bath.

days.title: ムオンホア渓谷トレッキング
days.morning: Trek Lao Chai – Ta Van through the rice terraces.
days.afternoon: Lunch at a homestay and shop for brocade in Ta Van.
days.evening: Stay with a Dao family, enjoy bamboo rice and local pork.

days.title: ターフィン村
days.morning: Visit the Red Dao village of Ta Phin and Ta Phin cave.
days.afternoon: Learn about brocade embroidery and take a herbal bath.
days.evening: Back in town, coffee overlooking Sa Pa at night.

days.title: バックハー市場
days.morning: Bac Ha Sunday market – the most colourful highland market in the Northwest.
days.afternoon: Visit Hoang A Tuong mansion and Bac Ha plum orchards.
days.evening: Try thắng cố and Ban Pho corn wine.
